sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.description:
Purpose The Determine Email Context for Work Mgt tool functions as a technical triage layer. It utilizes financial domain expertise to analyze inbound communications from the Interaction Record, extracting intent and generating the precise metadata required for automated case creation, routing, and compliance alignment. It specifically prioritizes operational continuity by identifying owner availability and flagging requests that fall outside the defined knowledge scope.
Input Interaction Record: The primary data object containing the raw inbound communication and associated session metadata.
Action & Logic Contextual Extraction: The tool processes the input against a tailored skill model—anchored in historical operational data and business reference architecture—to identify the underlying financial requirement.
Granular Classification: It transforms broad intent (e.g., "Payment Issue") into a specific, actionable classification (e.g., "Cross-Border Wire Transfer - Failed FX Validation"). This level of detail is mandatory for high-precision routing and SLA triggering.
Availability & Continuity Triage: The tool scans for "Out of Office" (OOO) signatures or automated replies. If an OOO is detected, it triggers the Out of Office Email Step to initiate immediate reassignment, ensuring the continuous progression of the outstanding work item.
Technical Parameter Mapping: The tool automatically maps the identified classification to the specific schema requirements of the downstream case management system. If the intent cannot be sourced, it flags the item as "Request Not Detected" to mandate a manual review.
Key Outputs The tool generates the following structural components for each identified work request, delivered in a standardized email reply format:
Email Context: A brief summary of the email's intent and relevant background, creating a complete data package for the record update.
Work Item Count: The total number of distinct work items identified within the communication.
Requirement Outline: For each identified item, the tool provides a Suggested Next Action (actionable recommendation) and a Responsible Group (the team required for execution).
